title: Overwatch Retail Patch Notes – July 18, 2019
raw_text: July 18, 2019 Overwatch Retail Patch Notes – July 18, 2019 A new patch is now live on Windows PC. Read below to learn more about the latest changes. To share your feedback, please post in the General Discussion forum For a list of known issues, visit our Bug Report forum. For troubleshooting assistance, visit our Technical Support forum. BUG FIXES General Fixed a bug that could cause updates to the chat feed to cause hitches in game performance. Top of post
